content: Xoossa sinththaninne hessaththoka paxa dizayta bollanne hayqqidayta bolla pirdanaas diza Yesus Kirstoosa sinththan iza qoncceththaanne iza kawoteththaa qofara hayssa nees hadara gays.
Qaalaa sabbaka; nees giigiin woykko giigontta aggiin neni ne baggara giigetta utta; daro dandayara tamaarson asaa suurisa; hanqanne zora.

Gaasoykka asay wuri suure gidida timirte ekkontta ixxana wodey yaana; hessafe bollara asay ba amora gaaggizayssa istta hayththi siyana koyzayssa xalla isttas yootana mala bana tamaarsana daro astamaareta ba ach shiishshana.
Tumaa siyanaappe ba hayth haraso zaaridi haysi7e bagga simmana.
Neni gidikko haniza yo7o ubbaan loddu ga; meto dandaya; mishiraachcho qaalaa yooto nees ooso histta; ne oosozakka pola.
Ta qasse yarshettanaas mata uttadis; hayssa ha alamezappe shaaketta buussa wodey taas gakkides.
Lo7o baaxe ta baaxetadis; ta woxxana woth wursadis; ammanokka naagadis.
Sinththafe taas akililey giigi uttides; hessika xilloteththa; hessaka tumu pirdiza Goday he gallas taas immana; hessika taas xalla gidontta iza yuussaa laamotizaytas ubbaasikka immana.
Phawuloosi Azazida Wurseththa Azazo
Taakko elela yaanaas nees dandayettida mala ooththa.
Deemaasi hayssa alameza siiqidi tana yeggi aggidi Tasolonqe bides. Qarqisi Galatiya bides; Titoosi gede Dalmaaxiya bides.
Luqaasi xalla tanara dees; Marqoosi tana ooson maaddiza gishshas iza nenara ekka ya.
Tiqiqoosa Efesoone yeddadis.
Ne haa yashe ta Xiro7aadan Karpuse achchan woththida ta Maaqanne maxaafata harappeka galban xaafettida maxaafata taas ekka ya.
Xarqimala qoxxiza Iskindiroosi ta bolla daro qoho gaththides shin Goday izas iza ooso mala immana.
Izi nu yootiza qaalaa keehi ixxides; nekka izappe naagetta.
Tana mootiza yo7ozas koyro tana ashshana markka ta shiishshiin oonikka tana maaddana yibeenna; gido attiin wurikka tana yeggidi bida. Hessaka istta bolla Xoossi qoho histti qoodoppo.
Gido attiin qaalaa kiitay ta baggara kumeth yootettana malanne dere asay wuri siyana mala Goday ta achchan eqqidi tana minththides; Gaammo doonappeka tana ashshides.
Goday iita yo7o ubbaafe tana ashshana; gede ba salo kawoteththas tana sarora gaththana; izas mernaappe mernaa gakkanaas bonchchoy gido. Amiin.
Wurseththa Saroka
Phirsiqillas, Aqilas, Henesifoore soo asaasikka ta sarokaa gaththa.
Erisxoosi Qorontoosen attides; Xirofomoosi sakettida gishshas iza ta Miliixen aggadis.
Balgoy gakkanaappe sinththetada taakko haa gakkanaas nees dandayettida mala ooththa. Ewuguloosi, Phudeesi, qasseka Linoosi, Qilawudiyaynne ammanizayti wurikka nena saro saro gida.
Goday nenara gido; Godaa kiyateththi inttenara gido.
